newsitem.title: CHINA: North Korea says talks with South not failure.
newsitem.headline: North Korea says talks with South not failure.

text.p: North Korea's Red Cross Secretary General Paek Yong-Ho said on Monday talks with South Korea did not break down and the two sides would meet again after the South decides on the amount of food aid it would give.
"It's not broken, it's not suspended, it will be continued," Paek told reporters.
"I cannot say we are disappointed or we are satisfied because we're in the middle," Paek said.
"We did not yet enter to the substantial discussion. We just opened the lid of the bowl," he said.
He said the two sides agreed to meet at a yet to be determined date and place after the South decides the quantity and kind of relief goods.
South Korean officials earlier said negotiators from Red Cross organisations in North and South Korea had failed to reach agreement on shipments of grain aid to the North.
